biography.html: Mindaugas Valuckas is a Lithuanian property developer and former Hanner executive and shareholder. He joined the company's board in 2009 and became group chief executive in 2013. His work has spanned residential and commercial development in the Baltic region and Romania, where he took charge of Hanner's operations in 2018.

long_biography.plain_text:
The surviving buildings of Bucharest's Grivița brewery changed Mindaugas Valuckas's plans for a land purchase. He chose to pursue their restoration as Fosta Fabrică, combining homes with workplaces and public space. He organised a paid competition for architects and worked with the chosen practice, Tecon, on function and efficiency while leaving architectural design to its specialists.

His interest in development also extends to what remains unbuilt. In Riga, he abandoned a proposed land purchase because creating an efficient office building would have meant felling an old tree. At Jaunā Teika, he advocated safer outdoor connections between neighbouring developments, extending his concern for shared space beyond individual buildings.

confidence.reason: His direct interview supports the brewery decision, competition, division of responsibilities and rejected land purchase. The landscape association's contemporary submission specifically supports his outdoor-connection vision; the prose does not claim all plans were built.
